name: Do I need a permit for electrical work during a remodel in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for electrical work during a remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most significant electrical work performed during a remodel in Berkeley, and throughout the East Bay, requires a permit from the local building department. This is to ensure that the work complies with the California Electrical Code and local amendments, safeguarding your property and occupants. Work such as adding new circuits, upgrading your service panel, or relocating major electrical components typically necessitates a permit and subsequent inspections. Your contractor or electrician should be able to guide you through the specific requirements and manage the permitting process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, most major electrical work during a remodel in Berkeley requires a permit to ensure compliance with state and local electrical codes.
